This harness registers no tool-less agent type (available: claude, Explore, general-purpose, Plan, statusline-setup, plain-language-writer, web-gatherer). Inlining the extraction prompt was ALSO not an option: extract-prompt.json contains the fetched document text, and pulling it into the coordinator's own context would break the F88 rule that page content travels only as files. AFK-default: all five brain seams (extract, judge x3, thesis, implication, narrator) were dispatched as subagent_type plain-language-writer on model opus - the narrowest available type that can reach NO web and NO shell - each reading its own prompt files and writing its own single answer file, with an explicit instruction to ignore that type's prose-rewriting persona and act as the frozen brain. The 'cannot reach outside its prompt' property is PRESERVED (no WebSearch/WebFetch/Bash on that type); what is lost is the tool-less purity of the extraction seam and the persona-neutrality of the agent type. NOTE: web-gatherer DID resolve this run, so the F88 gatherer wall was structural again (unlike the 2026-08-27 cycle). Needs the user: register a proper tool-less brain agent type.

EXTRACTION READ ITS OWN PROMPT FILE instead of receiving it inlined (AFK-default, same root cause as above).
